A module is currently being developed for the National
Research Data Infrastructure to enrich place-related
GND records with detailed geodata. Project partners are
the Berlin State Library and the Herder Institute for
Historical Research on East Central Europe.
“We want controllable openness that meets the
quality standards of a public institution”

“Since 2019 the DNB has also been trialling Wikibase, the
software backbone of Wikidata, for its own purposes. … This
cooperation was strategically underpinned in 2020 by the
jointly adopted WikiLibrary Manifesto, which aims at
building an open, semantic data network based on the
“the common goal: enabling access to knowledge”
Ogham Stone UCC Stone Corridor IV
The wikidata tag points to Q106680733, not to Q130529871. In
Wikidata the two are only linked via P1382 “partially
coincident with” – a link that needs documenting.
